2178. Rotate an Array Using Pointers

80

Hard

Given an array of N integers and an integer K, rotate the array to the right by K positions using pointers.

Your program must:

Read N integers into an array.

Read the rotation count K.

Pass the array address and its size to a function named  rotateArray() .

Perform the rotation using pointer arithmetic.

Print the modified array.
input_spec:
First line: Integer N.

Second line: N space-separated integers.

Third line: Integer K.
output_spec:
